name: Yakusoku Hitotsu, Uso Afureru Kurai.
original_name: 約束ひとつ、嘘あふれるくらい。
source:
I got fed up with this world, so I wouldn't care if I lost anything more... or so I lied to myself.
I didn't really want to lose anything anymore.
That's probably why I wanted to die.
But... I wouldn't think this choice was wrong.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6655]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
我厌倦了这个世界，所以我不在乎失去什么……或者说我欺骗了自己。
我真的不想再失去任何东西了。
这可能就是我想死的原因。
但是……我不认为这个选择是错误的。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6655]NovelGame[/url]]
